modelOverview: Unveiled at SIHH 2016, the RM 67-01 Automatic Extra Flat reimagines Richard Mille's tonneau silhouette in an ultra-slim, lightweight form aimed at everyday wear and sport. Its purpose-built Calibre CRMA6 skeletonised automatic movement is just 3.6mm thick, letting the case itself measure only 7.75mm despite the brand's signature open-worked architecture.

RM 67-01.movement: Automatic · Richard Mille Calibre CRMA6 · skeletonised, platinum rotor, 28,800vph · ~50h power reserve
RM 67-01.materials: Available in grade 5 titanium, Carbon TPT, and 18k rose/red gold case constructions
RM 67-01.dial: Fully skeletonised dial exposing the CRMA6 movement, with solid metal Arabic numerals mounted on titanium rails, hours, minutes and a date window at 5 o'clock
RM 67-01.description: The RM 67-01 Automatic Extra Flat strips the Richard Mille tonneau case down to just 7.75mm thick, built around the purpose-designed Calibre CRMA6 skeletonised automatic movement with a central platinum rotor. Its lightweight construction and low profile made it a favourite for sport and everyday wear, offered across titanium, Carbon TPT and rose gold executions. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Extra Flat Automatic – RM 67-01: The core RM 67-01 execution — ultra-slim 7.75mm tonneau case, skeletonised Calibre CRMA6 automatic movement with platinum rotor, oversized metal numerals on titanium rails, and a date window at 5 o'clock, offered in titanium, Carbon TPT and rose gold.

RM 67-02.movement: Automatic · Richard Mille Calibre CRMA7 · skeletonised, Carbon TPT and white gold rotor with OneWay winding system · 28,800vph · ~50h power reserve
RM 67-02.materials: Quartz TPT bezel and caseback with Carbon TPT caseband, in a range of national-colour athlete editions; elastic textile comfort strap; 32 grams complete
RM 67-02.dial: Skeletonised dial with a 0.40mm black DLC-coated titanium central bridge hand-painted in the colours of each athlete edition, hours and minutes
RM 67-02.description: The RM 67-02 Automatic Extra Flat takes the slim RM 67-01 format into a 32-gram sports watch, replacing metal with Quartz TPT and Carbon TPT and fitting a seamless elastic strap so the watch can be worn through competition. Its Calibre CRMA7 uses a Carbon TPT and white gold rotor, and the hand-painted central bridge distinguishes the athlete editions created for partners such as Wayde van Niekerk, Mutaz Essa Barshim, Alexis Pinturault and Sébastien Ogier. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Extra Flat Automatic – RM 67-02: The RM 67-02 Automatic Extra Flat — 7.80mm tonneau case in Quartz TPT and Carbon TPT, skeletonised Calibre CRMA7 with Carbon TPT and white gold rotor, elastic strap, offered in national-colour athlete editions.
